A '''New Republic officer''' served aboard [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Unidentified MC80 Liberty type Star Cruiser (Pallaxides)|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser]] during the [[battle of Pallaxides]]<ref name="Empire Lost 3" /> in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="Date">The events of [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 3]] are set approximately thirteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which marks the beginning of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the events of ''Empire Lost 3'' must have taken place around [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref>
